newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North sees flat trading in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North sees flat trading in 96/97.

text.p: Mining and forestry group North Ltd said on Thursday it expected flat trading in the 1996/97 year ended June 30, but saw profit growth improving in following years.

"The current indications are that the 1996/7 (year) will be a flat trading year with results being affected by subdued prospects for prices for most of our commodities," North chairman Micheal Deeley told the annual general meeting.
"The board expects to see improved profit growth in subsequent years as projects, including Alumbrera (copper-gold mine in Argentina), come onstream," Deeley said.

"Our existing businesses provide a solid base on which to build, and given average market conditions, this together with developments in the pipeline should lift profits substantially by 1998/99 and beyond," he said.
North reported a net profit of A$111.89 million in the year to June 30, 1996, down from A$116.37 million in 1994/95.
